questions.prompt_md: Choose the correct option: *Listen! Somebody ___ at the door.*
questions.explanation_md: *Listen!* indica que ocurre ahora mismo: present continuous.

choices.text: We didn't went to the meeting.
We didn't go to the meeting.
We not went to the meeting.
We don't went to the meeting.

questions.explanation_md: Negativa del past simple: *didn't* + infinitivo sin *to*.

questions.prompt_md: Write the past simple of the verb **bring** (one word).
Choose the correct option: *This warehouse is ___ than the old one.*
questions.explanation_md: Adjetivo corto terminado en consonante–vocal–consonante: se duplica la consonante, *bigger than*.

questions.prompt_md: *I've bought the books and enrolled online. I ___ start the course in January.* Choose the best option.
questions.explanation_md: Es un plan ya decidido y preparado: *be going to*. *should to* es incorrecto (modal sin *to*).
